name: Littmann Cardiology IV Stethoscope, Navy and Black
seoTitle: Littmann Cardiology IV Navy Stethoscope Gift
metaDescription: The Littmann Cardiology IV stethoscope in navy and black, a milestone gift for a nurse passing boards, graduating NP school, or moving into critical care.
summary: A Littmann Cardiology IV is the kind of stethoscope nurses talk about upgrading to, which makes it a big milestone gift for graduation or a new specialty.
whyItWorks: Ask nurses which stethoscope they hope to own someday and the Littmann Cardiology IV comes up again and again. It has a reputation as a career piece, the one they keep for years and drape around their neck through countless shifts. Giving one marks a moment, like passing the NCLEX, finishing NP school, or moving into the ICU.

The navy tubing with a black finish looks sharp and professional while being a little more personal than plain black. A stethoscope is also one of the rare gifts a nurse uses every single shift, so it gets remembered every time they reach for it. Many people choose engraving to add a name or credentials, so check the listing or the manufacturer for those options. For parents or partners wanting one big gift for pinning day, this is a classic choice. Wrap it with a stethoscope case or an ID tag to round it out.
goodToKnow: Check whether the nurse already owns a Littmann; if so, ask before buying a second one.
Look into engraving options separately if you want a name or credentials on it.
Model 6168 is navy and black; confirm the color on the listing matches what you expect.

faq.q: Is the Cardiology IV overkill for a new nurse?
faq.a: Not at all if it is a big milestone gift. Many nurses use theirs for years, and it is a stethoscope they will grow into.

faq.q: Is this a good NP graduation gift?
faq.a: Yes. It is a classic choice for nurse practitioners stepping into a new role where they will be assessing patients every day.
